method.selection: Purposive sample of six training boards with capacitors, connectors, ICs, switches, transistor parts, an inductor, an LED, a crystal, a ferrite bead and a trimmer. Long, rotated and uncommon literal labels were favored. This is not a random sample or an estimate of corpus-wide quality.
method.visual_inspection: Original full-page v3 PNGs inspected at their original 2400-pixel width; no source or image was edited.
method.source_verification: Each reviewed image, SVG and native source matched its v3 provenance SHA-256. NAME/VALUE coordinates are extracted from the pinned EAGLE source and current v3 transforms.
method.locators: Pixel anchors locate original NAME/VALUE labels using the stored SVG viewBox and default centered aspect-ratio mapping. Nominal font size is not measured glyph height or an OCR score. No separate crop image was produced.

status_meanings.native_resolution_readable: Reviewer could identify target name and literal value in this image. This is limited to the listed target and original resolution.
status_meanings.native_resolution_small_text_inconclusiv: No obvious collision observed for target, but small text prevents confident certification of every character.
status_meanings.potential_overlap_manual_review_required: Specific target/neighbor collision candidate needs adjudication; no automatic exclusion or renderer diagnosis.

limitations: No image was assessed after the deployed 1024-pixel resize or vision-processor tiling. All selected targets remain unreviewed at model inference scale.
Unreviewed targets are not certified by the outcomes for these 23 targets.
Inspection of a target does not certify its complete board image; unrelated source overlaps remain visible in some images.
The prior QT2040 and TFP401 exclusions are inputs, not additional reviewed sample targets. No new exclusion is applied by this report.

explicit_exclusions.reason: Manual review of the v3 QT2040 Trinkey image found target value/name glyphs coincident with the adjacent resistor. Preserve native evidence supervision; exclude the entire board/value group until another representative is visually reviewed.

Manual review of the v3 TFP401 image found overlapping resistor-array names and values, making target assignment ambiguous. Preserve native evidence supervision; exclude the entire board/value group until another representative is visually reviewed.

follow_up.action: Adjudicate potential collision with R4 before deciding whether to exclude this board/value group. No replacement selected.
Review small target text at actual model input scale before asserting trainable visual legibility.

reviewed_targets.observation: Upper-left polarized capacitor: rotated name and value are separate and identifiable.
Central reset capacitor: CSTBY above 1nF, with clear separation.
Far-right timing capacitor: COFF and 22nF are separate beside the symbol.
Left motor connector: rotated long terminal value and JP1 name are separated on opposite sides.

Lower-left trimmer: the end of the rotated 10Ktrimmer value touches or nearly touches adjacent R4 name. Native source anchor geometry is recorded, but this is not a confirmed renderer defect or an exclusion decision.
Lower-right inductor: L2 is beside the symbol and long component specification is below it.
Upper-left MOSFET: rotated Q1 name and AO3401A value are readable and separate.
Main IC: source places U1 well above the body and TPS65131 below. Both labels are legible; the large name/value separation is retained.
Right negative-output capacitor: C5 and 22uF/16V are separate to the right of the symbol.
Lower-right LED: long manufacturer code is above the symbol and LED1 below, without observed collision.
Lower-left regulator: U2 above and RT9193 below the body are legible.
Upper-left sensor: U1 above and exact value TCS34725 below are legible. Generic TCS3472x text inside the body is distinct from the value label.
Right slide switch: MSS12C02LS above and SW1 below are separated.
Lower-left connector: X1 above and JST 3SH below are readable. A vertical wire passes near the value but does not prevent this reading.
Lower-right USB/UART IC: U1 above and CH340E below the body are readable.
Upper-left USB connector: X2 above and USB TYPE C below are readable; generic USB C inside the symbol is separate.

Lower-left analog filtering block: FB1 and FERITTE appear separated. Preserve the literal source spelling FERITTE. Nominal font size is small enough that this review does not certify exact character legibility.
Upper-middle oscillator: long crystal part number is below the symbol and appears separate, but text is very small. Exact character legibility is not certified.
Upper-left output filter: rotated C21 and 10nF (0.01uF) appear separated; small text prevents confident certification of every character.
Lower-left power block: U2 and AP7312-1833W6-7 appear separated above/below the regulator. The small font needs closer pixel-level and inference-scale review.
Lower-right terminal: rotated X3 left of the symbol and 3.5mm Terminal below are readable.
Central transistor: Q1 and MMBT2222 to the right are clearly separated.
Lower-left header: 0.1-inch Header above and JP1 below are readable; the literal gold retains its inch quote.
